title: ToggleLogic owner-pin state file v2 (DRAFT)
description: Deployment-supplied owner-pin state. One file holds every scope. Written only by the togglelogic-pin CLI (atomic temp+rename); the routing hook reads it and never writes. The 'all' scope MUST carry expires_at_ms at set time (enforced by the CLI, not by this schema, because a value cannot be conditioned on its own key). A v1 file (no 'schema'/'pins' keys, override fields at the top level) is a separate, still-honored shape — see M6-PER-TASK-OWNER-PINS.md §3.2.

pins.description: Keyed by scope. 'all' is the all-tasks override; 'task:<label>' pins one normalized (lowercase/trim) host task label.

model_ref.description: Exact provider/model ref. Split on the FIRST slash (provider = head, model = tail) so multi-segment refs keep their tail.

family.description: A provider-qualified lineage accepted by lineage-resolver.validLineage, resolved to the newest configured+allowed member at decision time.

expires_at_ms.description: Optional for task:<label> scopes (holds until cleared if absent). Required at SET time for the 'all' scope (CLI-enforced). A present-but-non-integer value fails closed at read time (loud); true absence is honored (backward compatible).
